svg.text: Cross-species primary-protein MSA overview · 30 species, 1091 alignment columns
Where do the selected primary proteins agree, where do residues differ, and where does one species carry an insertion or deletion?
Pairwise identity 60.5% over 547 ungapped columns · 216 mismatch columns · 544 indel columns
Indel column (gap in at least one species)
Variable blocks are runs of at least 5 consecutive non-identical columns. Identity is computed on ungapped columns only and describes sequence similarity, not functional equivalence.
